entries.answer: HIV stands for Human Immunodeficiency Virus. It is a virus that attacks your body's immune system, which is your natural defense against sickness. If you don't treat it, it can make it hard for your body to fight off infections.

question_patterns: can I get HIV from kissing?
entries.answer: You can only get HIV through specific bodily fluids like blood, semen, vaginal fluids, and breast milk. The most common ways are having unprotected sex or sharing sharp objects like needles. You cannot get it from hugging, kissing, or sharing food.

question_patterns: na lie say mosquito dey give HIV?
entries.answer: No, mosquitoes cannot transmit HIV. Also, you cannot get HIV from toilet seats, shaking hands, hugging, sharing cups, or eating together. HIV cannot survive long outside the human body.

question_patterns: how I go know if I get HIV?
where I fit test for HIV?
entries.answer: The only way to know your HIV status for sure is to take a test. You can get tested at hospitals, primary healthcare centers, or use self-test kits available in pharmacies. The test is quick, easy, and completely confidential.

question_patterns: make I know about window period
how long before HIV test is accurate?
entries.answer: The window period is the time between when someone gets exposed to HIV and when a test can find it in their body. It usually takes between 10 to 90 days depending on the type of test. If you test during this period, you might need another test later to be sure.

question_patterns: what be the difference between HIV and AIDS?
is HIV the same as AIDS?
entries.answer: HIV is the virus that attacks the immune system, while AIDS is the most advanced stage of the infection. A person can live with HIV for many years without developing AIDS if they take their medication properly. With good treatment, most people with HIV never develop AIDS.

question_patterns: how person fit live long with HIV?
can I live a normal life with HIV?
entries.answer: Yes, you can absolutely live a long, healthy, and normal life with HIV. The secret is to start treatment early and take your daily ARV drugs as prescribed. Many people living with HIV work, have families, and achieve their dreams just like anyone else.

question_patterns: can I infect my partner if I am on drugs?
entries.answer: U=U stands for Undetectable = Untransmittable. This means if you take your HIV medication daily and the virus level in your blood becomes so low that tests can't find it (undetectable), you cannot pass HIV to your sexual partners. It is a huge medical breakthrough that helps stop the spread of HIV.
